# MetaPhase EDG

> MetaPhase EDG is a Solutions Integrator and SBA-certified 8(a), EDWOSB, and WOSB
> Small Business Joint Venture between MetaPhase, LLC and SharpEDG, LLC. It brings
> cutting-edge technology and strategic management consulting to the U.S. Federal
> mission. Tagline: "Problem Solvers for a Digital World."

## About

- Joint venture of MetaPhase, LLC and SharpEDG, LLC.
- Team of former Federal Senior Executives, expert technologists, and industry-recognized management consultants.
- Focus areas: digital transformation, IT modernization, cybersecurity, strategic planning, and program management for government agencies.

## Certifications & Clearances

- SBA 8(a) certified
- Economically Disadvantaged Woman-Owned Small Business (EDWOSB)
- Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB)
- Small Business Joint Venture
- Top Secret (TS) Facility Clearance

## Contract Vehicles

- GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS): contract number 47QTCA26D002G, effective 12/18/2025 – 12/17/2030 (period of performance to be confirmed), SINs 541611 and 54151S.
- MetaPhase SBIR Phase III Direct Award authority (originating agency: U.S. Air Force).
- Eligible for 8(a) sole-source awards as a certified joint venture.
- Additional GWAC, IDIQ, BPA, and agency-specific vehicles available through MetaPhase: https://metaphase.tech/contract-vehicles
